game.name: Tristam Island
game.author: Hugo Labrande
game.description: 1901. Your seaplane goes down in the North Atlantic and you wash ashore on a small island that the maps say is uninhabited. Hungry and alone, you soon suspect the maps are wrong. A full-length, classic-style parser adventure by Hugo Labrande, released free and open source under CC0. Runs on the Frotz Z-machine interpreter.
